title: Product & UX Researcher
description: At Aleph, we design human experiences by asking the right questions. Here, you’d find a curious breed of creative engineers spread across the globe, specializing in craft, strategy, and technology. With a keen ear to the ground, we turn big dreams into user-first digital solutions by design. Through rigorous prototyping, close collaboration, and responsive engineering, we commit to creating a future that leaves our craft, community, and clients better than before. ​​We’re looking for a skilled and curious Product & UX Researcher to join our team and support the revamp of a major banking platform. You’ll be embedded in a cross-functional project squad alongside UI/UX Designers and the client’s Product and Business teams. Your role is to uncover user needs, pain points, and opportunities — and to champion those insights to shape the next generation of banking experiences. As the team’s Researcher, you will own the end-to-end research process and help guide both product and design decisions. You’ll also contribute to defining post-launch success metrics to ensure the solutions we create have measurable impact. Here are your key responsibilities: Collaborate with the internal project squad and the client’s stakeholders to define research goals and select the most effective approaches (interviews, FGDs, participatory design, usability testing, surveys, A/B testing, data analysis, etc). Translate business questions into focused research plans and activities that generate actionable insights. Lead end-to-end research: plan, recruit, conduct, analyze, and report — including managing research operations for the project. Present findings in clear, structured, and compelling formats (e.g., report documents, insight decks, or synthesis frameworks). Act as a user advocate in design discussions, participating in ideation and helping shape the UX. Co-define product success metrics and performance indicators with the team; help build a framework for ongoing tracking and optimization. Ensure all research activities adhere to ethical and legal standards, especially around handling sensitive customer and financial data.

title: Data Platform atau Service atau Pipeline Operator
description: Data Service Operator Kualifikasi pendidikan minimal D3 bidang teknik informatika, sistem informasi, ilmu komputer, teknologi informasi, statistika, matematika, teknik industri atau jurusan setara terkait bidang studi Information Technology. Pengalaman kerja minimal 2 tahun di bidang data operation atau development. Pengalaman dan menguasai pengelolaan infrastructure configuration (server & network) serta OS configuration pada Linux dan Windows Server. Menguasai ekosistem containerized seperti Docker dan Kubernetes. Untuk level Senior dilengkapi dengan Certification System Administrator atau Kubernetes Administrator Certification. Pengalaman dan menguasai platform database pada level advanced/professional: MS SQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, Redis, dan Apache HBase. Menguasai query dan optimasi SQL & NoSQL pada clustered maupun non-clustered database. Pengalaman dan menguasai Web Server, API, Tableau Server, dan Microsoft Reporting Services, termasuk konfigurasi high availability dan clustering. Menguasai pengelolaan API, termasuk API berbasis GraphQL. Menguasai configuration dan optimasi platform data berbasis web server, API, serta containerized API platform. Menguasai proses automasi (monitoring, alert, notification, analisis) untuk platform web server, API, Tableau Server, dan Microsoft Reporting Service. Menguasai teknologi CI/CD seperti Jenkins dan Bamboo. Menguasai teknologi automasi seperti Ansible. Menguasai performance improvement dan tuning pada platform data berbasis web server, API, Tableau Server, Microsoft Reporting Service, maupun server. Mampu melakukan analisis data growth dan traffic service untuk memberikan rekomendasi capacity planning dan capacity management. Mampu menyusun dan mempresentasikan analisis, rekomendasi, dan insight terkait aplikasi berbasis web, API, maupun containerized API, kepada tim teknis maupun non-teknis dalam bentuk presentasi, dokumen, atau laporan berkala. Melakukan pengecekan detail pada object platform aplikasi (web, API, Tableau Server, Microsoft Report Server, dan containerized API) untuk mengidentifikasi isu atau potensi problem. Data Pipeline Operator Kualifikasi pendidikan minimal D3 bidang teknik informatika, sistem informasi, ilmu komputer, teknologi informasi, statistika, matematika, teknik industri atau jurusan setara terkait bidang studi Information Technology. Pengalaman menguasai di level intermediate terkait platform database (MS SQL, Postgresql, IBM DB2, Elasticsearch, MariaDB, MongoDB, Apache HBASE, Hive & Impala, HDFS, TigerGraph / Graph Database). title: Corporate Finance Governance
description: 1. Budgeting, Forecasting, and Financial Planning Lead annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, and long-term financial planning processes. Monitor budget utilization and ensure alignment with business strategy and revenue targets. Support management with financial scenario planning and business decision modeling. Improve financial planning accuracy and strategic resource allocation. 2. CAPEX Evaluation & Investment Feasibility Analysis Evaluate capital expenditure proposals, new projects, and expansion initiatives. Conduct ROI analysis, payback period assessment, and financial feasibility studies. Review business cases for new store openings, warehouse expansion, product launches, and strategic investments. Ensure investment decisions are financially sustainable and aligned with company priorities. 3. Business Expansion Financial Review Support strategic expansion planning across retail, distributor, manufacturing, and digital channels. Analyze profitability impact, funding requirements, and operational scalability of new business initiatives. Provide financial recommendations for partnerships, key accounts, and growth opportunities. Support long-term business sustainability planning. 4. Profitability and Business Performance Analysis Monitor business profitability by product, channel, branch, and business unit. Conduct margin analysis, cost optimization reviews, and performance benchmarking. Provide management with actionable insights for improving profitability and efficiency. Support commercial and operational teams with financial performance evaluation. 5. Delegation of Authority (DOA) Management Develop and maintain financial approval structures and Delegation of Authority (DOA) policies. Ensure clear approval ownership for spending, procurement, investment, and strategic decisions. Review authority limits and maintain governance discipline across departments. Strengthen accountability and reduce approval risks. 6. Approval Matrix and Governance Control Manage approval workflows for major financial commitments and strategic decisions. Establish governance standards for procurement, contracts, investments, and large operational spending. Ensure decision-making follows company policy, authority structure, and compliance standards. Reduce financial leakage and governance gaps. 7. Board and Executive Financial Reporting Prepare strategic financial reports for Managing Director, Board, and executive leadership. Support board meetings with investment summaries, financial risk analysis, and decision recommendations. Coordinate financial governance reporting and executive-level financial visibility. Improve decision transparency and executive oversight. 8. Policy Governance and Compliance Monitoring Develop and review finance-related policies, SOPs, and governance frameworks. Ensure compliance with internal controls, audit requirements, and regulatory standards. Support policy implementation and governance discipline across business units. Coordinate with Internal Control, Accounting, and Treasury teams for compliance alignment. 9. Financial Risk Governance Identify and assess financial risks across operations, investments, and strategic decisions. Strengthen preventive controls for fraud, authority abuse, and financial exposure. Support risk mitigation planning and governance improvements. Protect financial sustainability and business integrity.

description: We're hiring a Social Media Content Strategist to lead the creative vision, ideation, and strategic direction behind our short-form content engine across Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. This is the senior creative role on the social team. You are the person who has the ideas - who watches a long-form episode and immediately knows which fifteen seconds will stop a scroll, who sees a cultural moment and already has three concepts ready before anyone asks. You will be working directly with a creator who has over 4 million followers across platforms, with Instagram as the primary channel. Our content operation is structured like a studio with batch production, performance metrics, and AI-native systems. You own the creative engine - the ideas, the concepts, the narrative direction, and the quality standard. You manage the Content Producer who handles daily execution, publishing, and platform operations. Together you run a system that produces high-volume, high-quality content every day. This is a full-time remote position. We are looking for a senior creative operator who generates ideas naturally, understands modern platform dynamics at a deep level, actively integrates AI into workflows, and holds every piece of content to an elite standard. A genuine interest in health, beauty, and strong visual aesthetics is essential - this is the world we operate in, and you need to live and breathe it. Responsibilities Generate and develop original content ideas, concepts, and creative angles on a continuous basis. You are the primary source of what we make and why. Identify high-retention moments within long-form content and develop them into short-form concepts with clear hooks, narrative arcs, and platform-specific angles. Develop creative briefs and direction for each content cycle, giving the Content Producer and editors clear guidance on what to build and how it should feel. Lead trend research and cultural awareness across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, spotting opportunities early and translating them into on-brand concepts. Translate brand strategy into high-performing content concepts, story structures, and creative playbooks that guide all short-form output. Define and evolve the brand's visual and tonal identity across platforms, maintaining a cohesive and premium creative standard. Direct and approve content through production and post-production, ensuring quality, creative alignment, and platform-ready formatting before anything publishes. Manage the Content Producer by setting priorities, providing creative direction, reviewing output, and ensuring disciplined execution of the publishing calendar. Analyze performance data at a strategic level, identifying what is working, why it is working, and how to double down or pivot. Build and optimize repeatable creative systems, including AI-driven workflows that streamline ideation, editing, and production. Partner with the production team to ensure social-first thinking is embedded in long-form content capture and planning.

title: Social Media Content Producer *Superstar Only*
description: We're hiring a Social Media Content Producer to own the daily execution, publishing, and production operations behind our short-form content engine across Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. Plan, schedule, and publish short-form content across all platforms while maintaining a balanced mix of educational, inspirational, and trend-based formats. title: Director of Talent Acquisition & People Operations
description: Ready to Empower a Growing Team and Shape Our Future? Hadley Designs is redefining early education with creativity and purpose. Every product we create is hand-drawn and teacher-designed, crafted with care to build confidence and connection. Role Overview As the Director of Talent Acquisition & People Operations, you will own how Hadley Designs sources, vets, and closes top global talent, and you will own the broader people system that talent steps into. You will partner with leadership to design the recruiting engine that consistently delivers strong top-of-funnel for every open role, and you will scale the people systems that hold a remote, contractor-centric organization together as it grows toward $100M and beyond. This is a leadership-tier role with 1 direct report (the People Operations Specialist) and end-to-end ownership of the talent and people functions. Your weeks will be heavier on recruiting in the near term, live pipelines, structured interviews, test projects, employer brand, and steady on People Operations throughout (onboarding, performance frameworks, contractor renewal, leadership enablement). Key Responsibilities Talent Acquisition (the #1 outcome of this role): • Recruiting Pipeline Management: Source candidates across LinkedIn, job boards, freelancer platforms, and referrals; filter applicants for red flags, competency match, and scorecard alignment. • Test Project & Interview Operations: Run test projects, review submissions, conduct first-round group interviews, and manage candidate experience end-to-end. • Sourcing Channel Optimization: Manage and optimize sourcing channels based on performance; build "always hiring" shortlists for recurring high-leverage roles. • Employer Brand & Glassdoor Defense: Monitor and manage Glassdoor reviews, organize team review drives, ask for feedback, flag issues, protect brand rating. • Hiring Metrics & Funnel Reporting: Deliver weekly hiring pipeline reports broken down by channel and role; track funnel performance against KPIs. People Operations: • People Systems Leadership: Design and implement systems for engaging, onboarding, and retaining talent, aligned with the company's growth objectives. • Organizational Design and Capacity Planning: Collaborate with leadership to ensure that the organizational structure and workforce planning meet the evolving needs of the business. • Performance and Development Frameworks: Establish performance expectations, evaluation frameworks, and development pathways that drive accountability and growth across the organization. • Talent Experience and Retention: Build a consistent and professional experience for talent that reinforces employee engagement, satisfaction, and retention. • Workforce Insights and Reporting: Provide insights and data-driven recommendations to leadership to guide decision-making and improve workforce effectiveness. How Success Is Measured Talent Acquisition KPIs : • Average time to fill open roles: under 45 days. • Weekly applicant volume per active role: 250+ qualified applicants. • Weekly hiring pipeline report by sourcing channel: 100% completion, on time. • Completed candidate case studies available for review per role per week: 15+. • Glassdoor company rating: maintain 4.5+ average across the year. People Operations KPIs: • Successful implementation of people systems that directly support the business's ability to scale. • Strong employee retention rates, with high performance and engagement. • Improved leadership confidence in people systems, talent readiness, and organizational alignment. • Predictable, scalable people operations that contribute to the company's growth and success.

title: Backend Developer
description: Ringkasan Posisi Kami sedang membangun website e-commerce dan mencari Backend Developer untuk menangani backend aplikasinya, mulai dari API, database, autentikasi, hingga integrasi pembayaran. Pengembangan tidak akan berhenti di e-commerce. Ke depannya akan berlanjut ke website dan aplikasi internal lain untuk mendukung operasional perusahaan, sehingga posisi ini akan menangani beragam project dalam jangka panjang. Seluruh pengembangan berjalan di atas stack Next.js dan dikerjakan bersama tim Frontend. Tanggung Jawab Utama Backend & API Membangun dan mengembangkan API route handlers serta server actions di Next.js. Menjaga struktur kode tetap rapi dengan layered architecture (service & repository) supaya mudah dikembangkan dan di-maintain tim. Menerapkan input validation dan error handling yang konsisten di setiap endpoint. Database & Data Merancang dan mengelola database schema dengan Prisma (ORM) di atas PostgreSQL, termasuk meng-handle migration. Menulis query yang efisien dan menjaga konsistensi data, terutama pada operasi yang membutuhkan database transaction. Fitur E-commerce Mengerjakan fitur inti e-commerce: product catalog, cart, checkout, order, hingga inventory/stok. Mengintegrasikan layanan pihak ketiga seperti payment gateway, notification service (mis. email/WhatsApp), dan shipping/courier service. Keamanan & Autentikasi Membangun authentication dan authorization (mis. JWT via cookie httpOnly dan role based access control). Mengamankan aplikasi dari security vulnerabilities seperti SQL injection dan XSS, serta menjaga data user. Performa & Keandalan Menjaga aplikasi tetap responsif saat traffic tinggi, mis. lewat caching (Redis) dan query optimization. Menyiapkan logging dan error monitoring supaya masalah cepat terdeteksi sebelum berdampak ke user. Kolaborasi & Kualitas Kode Menyepakati struktur data dan API contract bersama Frontend Developer. Bekerja dengan rapi: Git, code review, dokumentasi secukupnya, dan testing sebelum rilis. Mendukung proses deployment ke server on-premise (mis. dengan Docker atau CI/CD).

description: Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes. Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. Through proactive engagement, personalized guidance, and timely intervention, the team influences key business outcomes, including customer acquisition, revenue growth, retention, and reactivation. The organization is built on operational excellence, accountability, and a culture of continuous learning, where coaching, experimentation, and performance optimization are central to how we work and scale. About the role As a Sr. Manager of Customer Success, you will serve as the operational backbone of the Success team, sitting between senior leadership and our frontline Success Managers. This is a hands-on execution role: you will be on the floor, listening to calls, in the data, and in the weeds alongside your managers every day. You will own the day-to-day operational rhythm of your leadership team, ensuring frontline managers have the coaching, clarity, and tools they need to hit revenue targets and develop their agents. You will also serve as the primary owner of manager performance, including direction in process improvement initiatives, and execution of strategy with cross-functional teams. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced, metrics-driven environments, leads with accountability, has a genuine passion for developing people leaders, and can translate complex performance data into clear, actionable direction for their team. What you’ll do Lead, coach, and develop a team of Customer Success Managers, fostering a high-performance culture through structured coaching, accountability, recognition, and career development. Establish scalable coaching frameworks that enable managers to improve team performance, call quality, customer outcomes, and data-driven decision making. Own the day-to-day operational rhythm, ensuring seamless execution through performance monitoring, real-time decision making, and effective cross-functional coordination. Serve as the primary escalation point for operational challenges, customer issues, and process questions, driving timely resolution and continuous improvement. Partner with senior leadership to execute revenue and customer success goals by translating business priorities into clear team objectives and measurable action plans. Analyze performance trends to proactively identify risks and opportunities, implementing targeted coaching and operational interventions to improve results. Leverage data and reporting to provide actionable business insights, empower managers to independently manage performance, and inform strategic decisions. Lead cross-functional process improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, team productivity, customer experience, and business outcomes. Ensure workforce planning, capacity, and resource allocation effectively support customer demand while maintaining service quality and team performance.
